name: superpowers-architecture
description: Architecture-first Superpowers for Codex: Wayfinder Agentic Foundations, one Design Change Set, exact phase handoffs, TDD, reviews, and verified implementation.

interface.longDescription: Use Superpowers Architecture to establish a Wayfinder Agentic Foundation and Blueprint-traceable roadmap, design one outcome as a stable DDI/FCA Design Change Set, apply the reviewed Foundation candidate, verify the resulting Foundation, install APPLIED.json as the sole Application Receipt, and carry exact policy-accepted artifacts through verified phase handoffs, TDD, reviews, and final verification. Autonomous is the default for new and existing workflows; Review-gated requires a new explicit opt-in.
defaultPrompt: Use Wayfinder to establish the Agentic Foundation and a Blueprint-traceable roadmap for my project.
Design one ready roadmap outcome as a single exact Design Change Set before implementation.
Carry the policy-accepted spec, resulting Agentic Foundation, and Foundation Application Receipt through exact phase handoffs.
